photos.desc: This species forms dense stands much like other annual colonizing grass species.
This species forms dense stands much like other annual colonizing grass species.
The long branches are stiff and wiry and mostly devoid of spikelets, which renders one of the common names "wiregrass".
The distinctly ribbed glumes and the two florets per spikelet where the upper is long-awned and disarticulates are distinctive of this species.
